claim_boundaries: Inference is conditional on eight observed ordered generator pairings.
The same test images were already measured in Qwen/Ministral; architecture views do not create a fresh independent source cohort.
The six-test FastVLM Holm family does not replace the earlier eight-test Qwen/Ministral family.
Input and localization diagnostics are exploratory and unadjusted.
The native alternative failed exact calibration and is not pooled.
Input pairing correspondence predates the measured VLM caches; first emergence inside the model is not established.
No accepted frequency matching, unseen-pairing generality, persistence, semantic specificity, shared vector basis or causal cache mediation is established.
